about.title: About Suraksha Setu
about.what: Suraksha Setu (“safety bridge”) brings emergency help, civic complaints, government-scheme guidance, blood-donor search and a Hindi writing assistant together in one simple app.
about.pilot: We are starting with Mahodiya village, Sehore district, Madhya Pradesh.
about.project: This is a student project for DSN3099 (Engineering Projects in Community Service) at VIT Bhopal.
about.notGov: Suraksha Setu is independent. It is not a government service and is not connected to any government office. Scheme information comes from official sources, which we show on every scheme.
about.helplines: In an emergency, always call 112. Suraksha Setu helps you reach help faster but does not replace official helplines.
about.teamBody: Ritik Agarwal (tech lead) and the Suraksha Setu team, VIT Bhopal.

privacy.title: Privacy & your data
privacy.intro: We collect only what we need to help you, and we tell you why.
privacy.collect1: Your name, mobile number and village — to create your account and route your complaints.
privacy.collect2: Your location, only when you send an SOS or file a complaint.
privacy.collect4: Your emergency contacts — used only to alert them during an SOS.
privacy.see1: Your SOS location: you, the people you send the link to (until it expires), and the officer for your area.
privacy.see2: Your complaints: you and the officers handling them.
privacy.see3: Blood donors' phone numbers are hidden until someone asks, and every request is recorded.
privacy.see4: Sahayak messages are answered by Google's AI service (Gemini, free tier), which may use them to improve its products. Only what you type is sent (never your phone number) — don't type private details.
privacy.keep1: SOS location trail: 90 days after the SOS ends.
privacy.keep3: Sahayak chats: 90 days after your last message.
privacy.deleteBody: Go to Profile → Delete my account. We remove your profile, contacts, donor profile and chats. Complaints stay without your name so the work can be finished.
